repository.note: Official repository corroborates Personio ownership, but the current full v2 surface is generated from the newer per-endpoint Developer Hub fragments.

authentication.personnel: Personio client credentials produce a stable personnel bearer for 24 hours. The pack enrolls the bearer manually because the connection auth union has no client-credentials renewal mode.
authentication.recruiting: Personio documentation describes a separately provisioned Recruiting API access token. Recruiting operations use a distinct connection and permission.
authentication.credential_lifecycle: POST /v2/auth/token and POST /v2/auth/revoke are excluded so client IDs, client secrets, requested scopes, tokens, and revocation remain connection-owned.
authentication.token_substitution: The pack does not claim that either enrolled bearer can substitute for the other credential context.

operational_notes.origin: All endpoint fragments declare exactly https://api.personio.de; every ingredient uses that origin-only base.
operational_notes.attribution_header: Every admitted operation fixes X-Personio-App-ID to RECUED, the official customer-integration header format.
operational_notes.beta_header: Operations that document a Beta header receive static Beta: true; callers cannot override it.
operational_notes.pagination: Cursor list operations replay only the cursor query value extracted from _meta.links.next.href on the same admitted method/path. Returned URLs are never followed as authority.
operational_notes.binary_download: The document download endpoint uses response_capture so bytes enter the warehouse CAS and never appear in op-step values.
operational_notes.errors: Non-2xx Personio problem responses fail the operation and preserve the provider response for error rendering.
operational_notes.scope_coverage: Exact personio:*:read/write identifiers found in each official endpoint page or operation description are declared as required_scopes.
operational_notes.no_implicit_grants: Leaf packs declare no default grants; every operation requires explicit install-time grant, and writes still require per-run approval.
operational_notes.project_source: The documented Project entity is source-eligible but deliberately deferred to the repository-mandated separate human field-path verification gate.

source_eligibility.evidence: Personio attendance periods, absence periods, recruiting applications, and webhook events are not relabeled as task entities.
The v2 surface has no durable user-authored note entity.

GET /v2/projects and GET /v2/projects/{id} document a genuine time-tracking Project with stable id, name, status, description, and updated_at fields. Declaration is deferred because docs/d-192-work-entity-sources-fanout-authoring-brief.md requires a separate human field-path verification gate before commit, and the user requested an autonomous committed pack.

operations.exclusion_reason: Credential lifecycle is connection-owned: client IDs, client secrets, access tokens, scopes, and revocation must not become operation arguments.
